This is a '''list of {{OBP|Shadow Pokémon|GO}}''' in {{g|GO}}. Shadow Pokémon with a {{shinystar/GO}} icon denote those whose [[Shiny Pokémon (GO)|Shiny]] forms has been obtainable during a bonus challenge. Shadow Pokémon with a {{bag/GO|Premier Ball}} [[Premier Ball]] icon denote species that, in at least one of any rotation, has been encounterable during the bonus challenge; these icons redirect to the Team GO Rocket member the Shadow Pokémon was most recently obtainable from.
